title: 5e-5: structural similarity search
description:
## Parent

sutra/83 (5e PRD: health metrics + similarity system)

## What to build

Structural similarity search over stored HRR vectors. Given a function symbol, find the top-K most structurally similar functions in the workspace.

- similarity/index.rs: load vectors from hrr_vectors table, compute cosine similarity against a query vector, return top-K results with similarity scores. Linear scan is fine at single-workspace scale (sub-ms for 10K vectors).
- MCP tool: sutra_similar(symbol, mode=strip|embed, limit=10). Returns ranked list of similar functions with similarity scores and file locations.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] similarity/index.rs with cosine similarity search over stored vectors
- [ ] sutra_similar MCP tool with symbol, mode, and limit parameters
- [ ] Returns similar functions with similarity scores, qualified names, and file locations
- [ ] Strip mode finds structurally similar functions (same shape, different names)
- [ ] Embed mode finds semantically similar functions (similar names and shape)
- [ ] Reasonable performance: < 100ms for 10K-symbol workspace

## Blocked by

- sutra/88 (5e-4: HRR encoder)"
